Ladakh leaders to meet government over demands, warn of protests

Leaders from Ladakh are scheduled to meet with the Indian government on September 9 to discuss their demands. Ahead of the talks, they have warned of renewed protests if their issues are not addressed. The discussions are expected to focus on constitutional safeguards and other demands for the region. One prominent leader stated that they are prepared for a decisive confrontation if negotiations fail.
